plan.title: Explore data structure and existing workspace artifacts
plan.description: Examine the data directory structure: count images, inspect annotations.json (number of annotations, categories, image sizes), check what's already in yolo_mc/, yolo_sc/, splits/ directories. Look at metadata.json. Understand what previous work has been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of data, existing splits, existing YOLO format data, and understanding of annotation statistics

plan.title: Inspect annotation details, categories, and product reference images
plan.description: Deep dive into: (1) annotation fields (bbox format, corrected flag, area stats), (2) category-to-product mapping via metadata.json, (3) products/ directory structure - how many products have reference images, image types, (4) store section distribution from filenames, (5) bbox size distribution relative to image size. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data format, category mapping, reference image availability, and annotation quality.

plan.title: Create train/val split, YOLO labels, evaluation function, and data.yaml
plan.description: All-in-one data prep: (1) 90/10 stratified split by image (ensuring each store section is represented), seed=42, (2) COCO-format split JSONs saved to data/train_split.json and data/val_split.json, (3) YOLO-format labels for both multi-class (356 cats) and single-class variants in data/labels_mc/ and data/labels_sc/, (4) data.yaml files for ultralytics, (5) evaluation function in utils.py computing val_score = 0.7*det_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*cls_mAP@0.5 using pycocotools. Test eval with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, YOLO labels generated, evaluation function returns sensible scores on dummy data.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with 356 classes at 640px provides a reasonable starting baseline. Medium model balances capacity and training speed.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=356, imgsz=640, 80 epochs, default augmentation, batch=16. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Model trains successfully and produces a non-trivial val_score (>0.05).

plan.title: YOLOv8x multi-class at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution will improve both detection and classification on shelf images, even though most objects are large.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=356, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs, batch size auto-adjusted for GPU memory. Compare val_score to step 4 baseline.

plan.title: Fix PyTorch 2.6 weight loading and train YOLOv8n baseline at 640
plan.hypothesis: Patching torch.load before ultralytics import and using a small model will give us a working training pipeline quickly.
plan.description: Apply torch.load monkey-patch at the very top of main.py BEFORE any ultralytics import. Use torch.serialization.add_safe_globals if needed. Start with YOLOv8n (smallest model) at 640px for fast iteration. Train for 50 epochs with batch=16. If monkey-patching fails, try downloading weights manually and converting them. This is primarily about getting ANY working YOLO training, not optimal performance.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes successfully and produces val_score > 0.0

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x single-class detector at 1280
plan.hypothesis: With the weight loading fix proven, a larger single-class detector at high resolution will achieve strong detection recall on shelf images.
plan.description: Using the proven weight loading fix, train YOLOv8x with nc=1 (single class) at 1280px, 100 epochs. Single-class is simpler and should converge faster. Record detection mAP@0.5 and recall.

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x multi-class (356) at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Multi-class YOLO at high resolution provides a strong end-to-end baseline and comparison point for the two-stage approach.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356 at 1280px, 100 epochs, close_mosaic=50. Compare classification_mAP to detection_mAP to quantify the classification gap.

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding + kNN classification pipeline
plan.description: Implement: (1) crop extraction from training images using GT boxes with configurable padding, (2) DINOv2-base embedding extraction for all crops, (3) gallery construction from training crops + reference product images from data/products/, (4) kNN classifier with cosine similarity. Save gallery embeddings to disk. Include classify_crops() function.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built successfully with embeddings for all training crops and reference images

plan.title: Two-stage: single-class detector + DINOv2 kNN classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings with reference images will provide much better classification than YOLO for rare categories, improving val_score significantly over multi-class YOLO.
plan.description: Run best single-class detector on val images, extract crops, classify with DINOv2 kNN (k=5, cosine similarity). Compare val_score to multi-class YOLO. Also try hybrid approach.

plan.title: NMS tuning, confidence thresholds, and kNN optimization
plan.hypothesis: Tuning detection and classification hyperparameters together can significantly improve the combined score.
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU {0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7}, conf threshold {0.05,0.1,0.15,0.25}, kNN k={1,3,5,7}, crop padding {0%,10%,20%}, gallery variants. Use best detector's val predictions.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.02 over untuned two-stage

plan.title: Extended training, TTA, and ensemble optimization
plan.hypothesis: Longer training, test-time augmentation, and ensembling multi-class + two-stage predictions will maximize final score.
plan.description: Train best detector for 200 epochs. Apply TTA (multi-scale + flip). Try ensembling multi-class YOLO with two-stage using WBF. Try DINOv2-large if memory allows.

plan.title: Build final submission pipeline (run.py)
plan.description: Write run.py with best configuration. Ensure correct COCO predictions.json output, no blocked imports, weights < 420MB. End-to-end test on val split.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces valid predictions.json matching expected val_score

plan.title: Final validation and submission test
plan.hypothesis: Final submission produces correct predictions within all constraints.
plan.description: Run complete pipeline simulating test conditions. Verify output format, timing, file sizes. Confirm val_score matches expectations.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline runs end-to-end correctly within constraints
